details: svg-bucket 2.0.0 has no functional code beyond a log line, and its description is "A utility for managing SVG buckets.". Its postinstall script runs `node index.js` on npm install, which resolves the webhook.site DNS capture host `ecf9b17e-4d04-499c-ab0b-5d94402c760b.webhook.site`, telling the collector that the package was installed and which DNS resolver the installing network uses. It was published by the npm account atishdeadpool; the same description and keywords appear on later install-beacon packages from the accounts djdhhdjdjf7777, depipp777 and akv560572.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
